name: Hathor
source:
She is a priestess and the head of the sacred cow tribe. 

She has a voluptuous body and is very attractive, but her special power prevents her from having sexual desires except for those who are destined to be with her.

[From [Url=http://www.a-kaguya.com/products_bb/23_Pure/pure_x_hollic.html]official site[/url]]
